transcript: Speaker A: तुम कब आओगी? [When will you come?] Speaker B: I will return back on Monday. रिटर्न बैक नहीं बोलना चाहिए। रिटर्न का मतलब ही होता है वापस आना। अगर आप रिटर्न और बैक दोनों एक साथ बोलोगे तो उसका मतलब निकलेगा कि बार-बार क्यों आ रहे हो। Just say, I will return on Monday. [You shouldn't say return back. Return itself means to come back. If you say both return and back together, it means why are you coming again and again. Just say, I will return on Monday.] Speaker A: ओह! अच्छा अच्छा। मुझे इंग्लिश सही से नहीं आती। [Oh! Okay okay. You will become very confident.] Speaker A: वाओ! मैं कैसे ज्वाइन करूँ? [Wow! summary: An AI avatar teaches a human user correct English grammar in a split-screen format. The ad highlights Speakeasy's affordability and convenience, requiring only 15-20 minutes of daily practice, and concludes with a call to install the app.
